description: Create acl_rule_allocations table. Replaces the arithmetic formula (VLAN_ID * 150 + HOST_OFFSET) used by hp5130-acl.sh to assign per-IP deny rule numbers in ACLs 3951 and 3953. The table maps each blocked IP address to a unique rule number in the range 1–19999 (below the blanket blocked-pool rules that start at 20000). Rule numbers are allocated on demand (lowest available) and freed when the block is removed, preventing collisions regardless of VLAN numbering.
notes: hp5130-acl.sh falls back to the old formula if DATABASE_URL is unset, so the migration is non-breaking. After applying, any pre-existing manual block rules on the switch will retain their old rule numbers until removed and re-applied.
